SELECT v.STRUCTURE_NAME, v.MATERIAL_CODE, v.MATERIAL_DESC, v.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, v.MOULD_QTY, v.NET_DEMAND_QTY, v.SCHEDULE_QTY, v.ONBOARD_DATE, v.UNQUALIFIED_QTY, v.PRODUCTION_QTY, v.LH_MARGIN, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DAY, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DATE, v.PLAN_CLOSE_DATE, v.DIFF_DAY, v.PRODUCTION_VERSION, v.FACTORY_CODE, v.YEAR_MONTH, r.CX_MACHINE_CODE AS CX_MACHINE, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct LH_MACHINE_CODE) AS LH_MACHINE FROM t_mp_month_plan_monitor v LEFT join T_MP_MOULDING_DAY_RESULT r ON r.PRODUCTION_VERSION = v.PRODUCTION_VERSION AND r.MATERIAL_CODE = v.MATERIAL_CODE AND r.IS_DELETE = 0 LEFT join t_lh_schedule_result lh ON lh.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = v.PRODUCTION_VERSION AND lh.MATERIAL_CODE = v.MATERIAL_CODE AND lh.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE v.IS_DELETE = 0 AND v.year = #{year} AND v.month = #{month} AND v.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 0 FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f WHERE f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f.PRODUCTION_VERSION = v.PRODUCTION_VERSION AND f.MATERIAL_CODE = v.MATERIAL_CODE AND f.YEAR = v.YEAR AND f.MONTH = v.MONTH AND f.FACTORY_CODE = v.FACTORY_CODE )
AND r.CX_MACHINE_CODE like concat('%', #{cxMachine}, '%')
AND v.STRUCTURE_NAME = #{structureName}
AND LH_MACHINE_CODE like concat('%', #{lhMachine}, '%')
AND v.MATERIAL_CODE like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
AND v.MATERIAL_DESC like concat('%', #{materialDesc}, '%')
AND v.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC like concat('%', #{mainMaterialDesc}, '%')
GROUP BY v.STRUCTURE_NAME, v.MATERIAL_CODE, v.MATERIAL_DESC, v.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, v.MOULD_QTY, v.NET_DEMAND_QTY, v.SCHEDULE_QTY, v.ONBOARD_DATE, v.UNQUALIFIED_QTY, v.PRODUCTION_QTY, v.LH_MARGIN, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DAY, v.EXPECTED_CLOSE_DATE, v.PLAN_CLOSE_DATE, v.DIFF_DAY, v.PRODUCTION_VERSION, v.FACTORY_CODE, v.YEAR_MONTH, r.CX_MACHINE_CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_MONITOR t INNER JOIN ( SELECT f.MATERIAL_CODE, f.production_version, sum( q.DAY_FINISH_QTY ) production_qty FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f INNER JOIN t_lh_day_finish_qty q ON q.FACTORY_CODE = f.FACTORY_CODE AND q.MATERIAL_CODE = f.MATERIAL_CODE AND q.FINISH_DATE BETWEEN concat( #{year}, '-', #{month}, '-1' ) AND DATE_SUB( DATE_ADD( concat( #{year}, '-', #{month}, '-1' ), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ), INTERVAL 1 DAY ) AND q.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND f.YEAR = #{year} AND f.MONTH = #{month} GROUP BY f.MATERIAL_CODE, f.production_version ) f ON f.production_version = t.production_version AND f.MATERIAL_CODE = t.MATERIAL_CODE SET t.PRODUCTION_QTY = f.production_qty, t.LH_MARGIN = t.SCHEDULE_QTY - ifnull(f.production_qty ,0) WHERE t.is_delete = 0 AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.YEAR = #{year} AND t.MONTH = #{month}
